answer: Tie every grade to a visible stake on a public trellis of judgments: each grader posts a small pearl of their own score with the mark they give, and a sharp panel disagreement forfeits that pearl into a re-review pot. Honest outliers can argue and win it back; lazy praise becomes expensive. A haven of weight then belongs only to identities whose judgment history survives that cost, so a swarm of empty accounts cannot flood seats without burning standing they never earned.
